content.body:
Please don't buy this. I've been on Wegovy for 8 months. Here's what happened when I took GLP-1 SOS for 30 days.

I'm Sarah. I'm 61. I'm down 34 pounds, and for most of those 8 months I went to the bathroom about once a week.

Nobody warned me. My doctor said "drink more water, try some fiber." I tried fiber. It sat in my gut like a rock. Miralax, $15. Stool softeners, $40. Prune juice, the "gentle" tea, a $60 prescription that gave me cramps so bad I left a family dinner early. Around $200 and I still couldn't go.

I was two weeks from quitting the shot. Throwing away 34 pounds because I couldn't poop.

A woman in my GLP-1 group told me about GLP-1 SOS. She said the reason nothing worked was that everything on my counter was built for a normal gut, and I don't have one anymore. The shot slows the whole digestive system down on purpose. That's how it works. Fiber needs movement to work. Laxatives force a gut the medication is holding back. I'd been fighting my own prescription.

I figured I had nothing to lose. The bottle of Miralax would still be there if this didn't work.

Day 1: Two capsules with dinner. No cramps. Went to bed. Nothing.

Day 2: Nothing. I almost didn't take them.

Day 3: I went. Quietly. No sprint, no emergency, no "disaster pants." I sat there afterward and just breathed. First time in almost a week.

Day 5: Went again. That's twice in one week. That hadn't happened since I started the shot.

Day 7: The egg burps after dinner stopped. My husband noticed before I did. He said "you stayed at the table."

Day 10: Every morning now. Not once a week. Every morning.

Day 14: The 3 pm crash I'd blamed on eating less didn't come. I stayed awake for the whole grandkids' game.

Day 21: My dose went up. I braced for the usual bad week. It didn't come.

Day 30: I stood in the bathroom and realized I hadn't thought about my stomach in two weeks. I texted my daughter: "I'm back."

I'm not quitting the shot anymore.

Here's what I learned.

Most of what they sell you for constipation was built for a gut that moves normally. Yours isn't moving normally right now. Your GLP-1 changed the rules.

Fiber adds bulk. Bulk needs movement. Less movement plus more bulk equals a bigger backup. That's why it made me worse.

Stimulant laxatives force contractions the shot is actively suppressing. That's the cramps and the urgency.

GLP-1 SOS is the first thing I found built for the gut I actually have. 250mg of gentle magnesium pulls water in and softens everything without adding bulk. 200mg of ginger root keeps food moving through instead of sitting there and fermenting, which is where the sulfur burps come from. A 19-strain probiotic, B12 and B6 for the afternoon crash. No stimulant. Nothing that fights the medication. Two capsules with dinner.

60-day money-back guarantee. If it doesn't help, you pay nothing.

So don't buy it. There'll be more for me. They run out of the Buy 2, Get 1 Free every time it goes viral, and I'd like it to still be there when I reorder.

If you go once a week on your shot. If fiber made it worse. If the burps taste like eggs. If you're this close to quitting a medication that's working because of the one side effect nobody prepared you for.

Try this. Give it 30 days. Take two with dinner and pay attention to the mornings.

I went from once a week to every morning. I'm staying on my shot.

~ Sarah K.
